method.match: normalised title as a whole-word substring of the lower-cased, whitespace-collapsed text; no scrubbing applied (D53)
method.ci: 95% percentile bootstrap, 10,000 resamples of the unit named in `resampled`

reference.labels: Fit = Good Fit or Potential Fit; No Fit (D47)

note: Agreement with a documented panel rule, not correctness. Per-JD AUC over JDs with both a Fit and a No Fit candidate; CIs resample JDs (10,000). `llm_free` = pairs whose label needed no LLM tie-break.

SBERT (weak fine-tuned).trained_on: weak pairs, A2 train region (metadata labels), text_v2

selection.not_run: every text_v2 rung here is exploratory (plan 2026-10-06 02 §2); selection under D53 waits for the registered rungs
